annotations.title: Daily price index by country and category

description: The daily price index per country and category (median EUR price of products and the 7-day change), computed once a day from current prices. Without from/to: the latest day of each country. category "all" = the whole country. Costs 1 credit (0.002 USDC with x402).

country.description: Limit to these countries (ISO-2 country code in lower case (al, at, ba, be, bg, ch, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hr, hu, ie, is, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, rs, se, si, sk, tr)); default all.

name: price_index
